title: Find a Boatcode Agent
summary: This page provides information about the Hull Identification Number (HIN), or Boatcode, a unique numbering system for vessels, and helps you find a Boatcode Agent.

faqs.q: What is the Hull Identification Number (HIN) or Boatcode?
faqs.a: The HIN, or Boatcode, is a unique numbering system for vessels. It is attached to the hull on most boats, or permanently during manufacture in newer boats.

faqs.q: How can I get an HIN for an older boat?
faqs.a: A Boatcode Agent can help you get an HIN for older boats.

faqs.q: Where can I find a Boatcode Agent?
faqs.a: Transport for NSW (TfNSW) has established a network of Boatcode Agents throughout NSW who can help you find one near you.
